messages:
morgan: Heads-up — hit a weird edge with long-lived SSE streams in the Python SDK when an auth refresh happens mid-stream. sample app opens a streaming chat, token refreshes (401), SDK retries and reconnects automatically, and I get duplicate final chunks and a hanging iterator that never finishes.

sam (py-sdk): can you paste a tiny repro? also which sdk version and auth method (oauth vs api-key)?

morgan: using py-sdk 0.9.2, API key via env, but token is rotated by our infra (short-lived). minimal repro:

```py
async with client.stream("chat.completions", model="x") as s:
    async for chunk in s:
        print(chunk.text)
```

When the token rotates the SDK logs show an automatic reconnect: it resumes and prints the final chunk twice (same id) and the async for never exits (no StopAsyncIteration).

leah: does the __aexit__ for the stream context run? we rely on that to flush/close sockets in sample apps.

morgan: looks like __aexit__ isn't being awaited in the reconnect path — log excerpt: 

```
I 2026-02-25T12:01:02 reconnecting stream (reason=401)
I 2026-02-25T12:01:03 stream resumed (session=abcd)
W 2026-02-25T12:01:04 duplicate final-chunk id=xyz
```

and a coroutine was left pending in our app's event loop.

sam (py-sdk): ok this rings two bells: 1) our transparent retry behavior currently tries to reconnect on 401s which is probably the wrong default for long-lived streams that expect client-side lifecycle control; 2) we didn't guarantee generator cleanup when reconnecting. both can cause duplicate delivery or resource leaks.

proposal:
- add explicit Stream.cancel() / Stream.close() API that closes underlying socket and raises a StreamCancelled error for the iterator.
- change default behavior to NOT auto-reconnect on auth failures for streaming endpoints; surface an error instead.
- ensure __aexit__ semantics always run (await cleanup) even if reconnect attempts are made.
- add typing: AsyncIterator[StreamEvent] and a Stream.close() coroutine in stubs.

leah: thumbs-up for explicit close API. also docs need a short section about token refresh patterns for streaming. current quickstart uses API key env which hides this.

morgan: i can make a small repro gist and add to the bug report: https://gist.github.com/morgan/stream-repro

sam (py-sdk): thanks. i'll open a patch: add Stream.close() (async), make reconnect opt-in via a new StreamConfig(auto_reconnect=False), and tighten the context manager cleanup. i'll add tests for double-final-chunk and pending tasks. will also add an entry in the migration notes.

ci-bot: Created issue RED-DEVEX-1427: \"py-sdk: streaming auth-refresh causes duplicate final chunks and iterator leak\" (https://tracker.internal/red-DEVEX-1427)

leah: nice, please tag me on the PR.

morgan: huge thanks — this blocked a sample app demo today, so eager for the fix :thumbsup:

sam (py-sdk): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-sdk/pull/1234 — includes close()/cancel(), type hints, and a docs snippet. i'll put up a canary build after tests.

morgan: will test canary and report back.
